chart.invalidSamples: Samples must be numeric lists, up to 10000 per row and 50000 in total.
chart.nonnegativeData: Pie, funnel and radar charts require nonnegative values.
chart.positiveData: At least one value must be greater than zero.
chart.radarData: Radar charts require at least three distinct dimensions.
chart.integerData: Stem and leaf plots require integer samples. Convert units first.
chart.duplicateCategory: Category names must be unique within a series.

help.general: Categories identify axis groups. Rows in the same series form a data set; multiple series appear side by side. Double click a chart in the note to edit it again.
help.scatter: X and value are the horizontal and vertical coordinates. A blank X uses the row number. Series group points; negative coordinates are preserved.
help.histogram: Values or comma separated raw samples are binned into frequencies. Zero bins selects automatic binning. The maximum falls in the last bin.
help.box: Each sample list forms a group, or rows with the same series form one sample. Quartiles use linear interpolation; whiskers use 1.5 times the IQR.
help.violin: Enter raw sample lists or rows grouped by series. Width represents Gaussian kernel density with an automatically calculated bandwidth.
help.waterfall: Values are increments or decrements. A total starts at zero and sets the cumulative starting value for subsequent steps.
help.errorBar: Value is the center; error is a symmetric plus/minus interval. Bounds are value minus/plus error.
help.combo: The first series uses bars and the others use lines. A single series displays both bars and a trend line.
help.stemLeaf: Enter integer samples. Tens form stems, units form leaves. Negative stems are marked separately; the leaf unit is 1.
